title: QFT Zoo spectrum file (2d CFT torus partition function)
description: Z(q, qbar) = sum over Z entries [i, j, coef] of coef * b_i(q) * conj(b_j(q)), where block b(q) = q^(h - c/24) * sum_n coeffs[n] q^(n*step). The build checks modular invariance, integrality, a unique vacuum and the spectral gap.

member.description: For a family: which member this spectrum belongs to.

chiral_algebra.description: LaTeX name of the chiral algebra whose characters the blocks are (if they are characters).

irreducible.description: true if every block is an irreducible character of chiral_algebra and every Z coefficient is a multiplicity; the site then lists the primaries.

Z_tex.description: The partition function in LaTeX (no surrounding $).

character_tex.description: Closed form of the blocks, Markdown with $...$ math.

description.description: How the spectrum was obtained, Markdown with $...$ math.

generator.description: Script in this repository that produced the file.
